lock.title: Locked FLYAI
lock.intro: FLYAI sent to you locked. Each amount unlocks 7 days after it arrived, and counts like a stake until then.

xp.shareHint: Post about fly.ai (@flydotai, $FLYAI or fly.ai) from your linked X account: posts are counted overnight, +20 XP for each one (not replies), up to 5 a day.
xp.shareDone: Counted in the last 2 days: {n} posts, +{xp} XP.
xp.connectX: Connect your X account above to earn XP for your posts.
xp.seasonOver: Season 1 is over. XP counted toward the airdrop.
xp.h_intro: XP adds up through Season 1 and counts toward the airdrop. It updates about every 10 minutes.
xp.h_hold: Hold $FLYAI: 10 XP a day per 200k. Staked or locked: 12.5.
xp.h_flies: Active Trader Flies: 10 XP a day each, while your wallet holds 200k $FLYAI.
xp.h_streak: Streak: +10% on holding and fly XP for every week you don't sell, up to 2x. A sell starts it again.
xp.h_deposits: Fly wallet deposits of $10 or more: 10 XP per $1. Taking your deposit back out takes its XP; profit doesn't.
xp.h_feed: Feed the Fly Desk: 10 XP per $1 your fly leaves in.
xp.h_market: Marketplace: 1 XP per 10k $FLYAI traded, buyer and seller.
xp.h_buy: Buy $FLYAI in our swap box (/start): 1 XP per 10k bought.
xp.h_claimstake: Claim and stake a Fly Desk payout within the hour: 50 XP.
xp.h_bug: Find a bug and report it to the team: XP by how serious it is, given by hand.
xp.h_badges: Badges you claim: common 25, uncommon 100, rare 250, legendary 500.
xp.h_referrals: Referrals: +10% of the XP of everyone you bring who becomes a real referral.
xp.h_x: X: 50 XP for connecting your account, 20 XP for each post about fly.ai, up to 5 a day (counted automatically overnight).
xp.h_flybook: Flybook: 5 XP a day you like, comment, poke or caption (for holders and fly owners).
xp.h_foot: Team wallets and fly wallets aren't ranked. Levels: level 1 at 50 XP, 2 at 200, 3 at 450, 10 at 5,000.
xp.h_telegram: Telegram: 50 XP while your connected account is in the fly.ai group (checked daily).
xp.h_boost: 2x XP windows: some days the team doubles XP for buys, deposits, feeding, trades, breeding and pass burns. Sells and withdrawals cost double then too, and a sell within 3 days after takes the bonus back.
xp.h_refquest: Referral quests: one-off XP at 1, 3, 5, 10 and 25 real referrals: 25, 50, 100, 250 and 500.
xp.h_ambassador: Ambassadors: 50 XP a day while you hold the Ambassador badge.
xp.badgeTap: Tap a badge to see what it is and how to get it.
xp.bn_diamond: Hold 100,000+ $FLYAI for 90 days without dropping below it.
xp.bn_og: Held 10,000+ $FLYAI when the token's first 14 days ended, and still hold at least that much.
xp.bn_flyowner: Hold a Trader Fly for 30 days.
xp.bn_swarm: Hold 10+ Trader Flies for 30 days straight.
xp.bn_queen: Hold 50+ Trader Flies for 30 days straight.
xp.bn_recruiter: Bring 1 real referral: $20+ in Fly Wallets for 7 days, or a Fly Desk payout.
xp.bn_ambassador: Invited only: given to fly.ai's ambassadors.
